title: Aureline M5 review pack required-evidence / check result
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for one required-evidence / required-check row and its evaluator result. Names the object class, its review-pack association, the required evidence or check, the evaluator result class (provider-authoritative, local-parity-estimate, not-evaluated-here, ci-only, provider-unavailable), and the evidence anchor that satisfies it — so a ci-only or not-evaluated-here check is never folded into a green summary. Downstream merge-readiness, review detail, the review-pack summary, and support / export packets point at this schema instead of restating a check result by hand. Raw check outputs, raw command lines, secret values, and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
